title: Is Weight Tying Still Beneficial for Decoder-Only LLMs in Private Settings Under DP-SGD?
abstract: arXiv:2609.40335v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Differentially Private Stochastic Gradient Descent (DP-SGD) is a leading approach for privacy-preserving fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs). Many decoder-only LLMs employ weight tying between input and output embeddings, a design choice originally introduced for parameter efficiency and improved language modeling performance in the non-private setting. However, the impact of weight tying under differentially private training remains largely unexplored. In this work, we investigate the role of weight tying in the DP setting using GPT2 and DistilGPT2 as representative decoder-only architectures. Interestingly, we find that untied embeddings consistently outperform weight-tied models under DP-SGD, achieving gains of up to 4.74% points in accuracy on SST-2, QNLI, and QQP. translated_title: 在DP-SGD差分隐私设置下，权重共享对仅解码器大语言模型是否仍然有益？
translated_abstract: 差分隐私随机梯度下降（DP-SGD）是大语言模型（LLM）隐私保护微调的主流方法。许多仅解码器的大语言模型在输入嵌入和输出嵌入之间采用权重共享，这一设计最初是为了在非隐私设置下提高参数效率并改善语言建模性能而引入的。然而，权重共享在差分隐私训练中的影响在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这项工作中，我们以GPT2和DistilGPT2作为代表性的仅解码器架构，研究了权重共享在差分隐私设置中的作用。有趣的是，我们发现在使用DP-SGD时，解绑嵌入的模型始终优于权重共享的模型，在SST-2、QNLI和QQP数据集上准确率最高提升达4.74个百分点。除了提升模型实用性外，解绑嵌入还使得DP-SGD能够使用内存高效的幽灵剪裁技术。相比之下，权重共享会引入共享参数的问题……
tldr: 该研究发现，在DP-SGD差分隐私训练下，解除输入输出嵌入的权重共享不仅能稳定提升仅解码器LLM的性能（准确率最高提升4.74个百分点），还能支持内存高效的ghost clipping技术。
en_tdlr: Under DP-SGD, untying input and output embeddings consistently outperforms weight tying in decoder-only LLMs, yielding up to 4.74% accuracy gains and enabling memory-efficient ghost clipping for differentially private training.
